messages:
maya: Heads-up — KPI explorer drilldowns show a big spike for the quantized 'redwood-mini-v2' runs on dataset 'subset_A'. looks suspicious.
liam: saw that too. spike only for the quantized variant, not fp16. probably a data munging thing in the scorecard aggregator.
nora: can you paste the query/filter you used? i want to check joins with the eval-runner outputs.
maya: sure — this is the dashboard query slice I used:
```
SELECT model, quant, AVG(metric_value) as avg_val
FROM eval_scores
WHERE dataset='subset_A' AND metric='exact_match'
GROUP BY model, quant
ORDER BY avg_val DESC
```
liam: hmmm. eval-runner writes metric_value=null for failed cases. our frontend code coerces null -> 0 in the aggregate, which inflates averages for quantized ones (more failures logged as null).
aj: that matches the log I saw: quantized runner returned 'no_answer' rows for ~4% of prompts. those rows have no metric_value.
nora: easy fix in the dashboard: use COUNT(metric_value) in denominator or filter out nulls. Also show a separate "valid_samples" column so users see how many points contributed.
maya: agree. we should also change the scorecard to surface a small warning badge when nulls > 1% for that slice.
liam: note: our current metric def doc uses pass@1 and reciprocal_rank inconsistently across datasets. suggest we add per-metric explainers in the drilldown tooltip.
aj: filing ENG-ML-487 to track: "KPI explorer: null metric handling + drilldown metadata". PR coming with frontend tweak and query patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-dashboard/pull/842
devex-bot: PR 842 referenced by maya in eng-ml channel — builds queued.
maya: quick example fix (bigquery) I'd apply to the saved view:
```
SELECT model, quant, SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(metric_value), COUNTIF(metric_value IS NOT NULL)) as avg_val,
       COUNTIF(metric_value IS NOT NULL) as valid_count
FROM eval_scores
WHERE dataset='subset_A' AND metric='exact_match'
GROUP BY model, quant
```
nora: perfect. frontend should ignore rows with valid_count == 0 and render a subtle "no valid samples" state instead of 0.
liam: also a note for the eval-runner: quantized runs sometimes set metric_value to the string 'NaN' when conversion fails. we should normalize to SQL NULL upstream. I'll open a small runner PR.
aj: opened runner PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/219 — normalizes 'NaN' -> null, adds logging for failure reasons.
maya: once both PRs land, we should re-run the nightly evals and add a quick compare in the scorecard: before vs after fix to prove spike disappears.
ci-bot: nightly-evals #2026 completed — some flakes, but main suite OK.
liam: assigning myself to the dashboard patch, nora can you review the tooltip text edits? cc @aj for runner changes.
nora: will review today.
maya: thanks team. putting a small note on the dashboard: "Known issue: null metrics may inflate averages; fix in flight (ENG-ML-487)" until deploy.
liam: will follow up with a short changelog entry for the release notes.
maya: :thumbsup:"
